description:
Hushfacebook v0.1.6 targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 (com.facebook.katana), and 577.0.0.50.72 still works.

Settings are easier to scan in dark and light themes. Actions stand out, Pause has a visible badge, and shorter descriptions explain what each control does. The Save folder dialog confirms the name it saved, diagnostic choices describe their reports, and project links open from the Licenses screen.

There are 21 patches in all. Sponsored and suggested posts leave the news feed without a gap, and ads are gone from Stories and Reels. Facebook stops downloading ads in the background and sending ad telemetry. Links open in your browser, media can be saved, and you can choose an AMOLED black or Material You theme.

Validation: 389 runtime tests passed locally. All 115 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lint checks. All 21 patches applied to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 with no manifest changes. Signed-in feed and Story checks still need an isolated test session.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 from APKMirror. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
